description: This file declares functions and structures related to URL parsing and decoding, such as detecting URLs, decoding percent-encoded strings, and handling URL parameters.

methods.name: is_url
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid URL.

methods.name: is_urlschemechar
methods.description: Determines if a character is valid in a URL scheme.

methods.name: url_decode_mem
methods.description: Decodes a percent-encoded URL string with specified length.

methods.name: url_percent_decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL with percent-encoding, handling sequences before a colon.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_name
methods.description: Decodes a URL parameter name from a query string.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_value
methods.description: Decodes a URL parameter value from a query string.

methods.name: end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Appends a slash to the end of a URL in a strbuf structure.

methods.name: str_end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Creates a new string with a slash appended to the URL.
